# 1 Kings Chapter 16 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** And-the-word-of YHWH came to-Jehu son-of Hanani against Baasha, saying,

**2** "Because I-raised-you from the-dust and-made-you prince over my-people Israel, and-you-walked in-the-way-of Jeroboam and-caused my-people Israel to-sin, to-provoke-me with-their-sins —

**3** behold, I am-burning-after Baasha and-after his-house, and-I-will-make your-house like the-house-of Jeroboam son-of Nebat.

**4** The-one-belonging-to-Baasha who-dies in-the-city, the-dogs will-eat, and-the-one-belonging-to-him who-dies in-the-field, the-birds-of the-heavens will-eat."

**5** And-the-rest-of the-acts-of Baasha and-what he-did and-his-might — are-they not written in-the-Book-of the-Chronicles-of the-Kings-of Israel?

**6** And-Baasha lay-down with his-fathers and-was-buried in-Tirzah. And-Elah his-son reigned in-his-place.

**7** And-also by-the-hand-of Jehu son-of Hanani the-prophet, the-word-of YHWH came against Baasha and-against his-house — both because-of all the-evil that he-did in-the-eyes-of YHWH, to-provoke-him with-the-work-of his-hands, to-be like the-house-of Jeroboam, and-also because he-struck-it.

**8** In-the-twenty-sixth year-of Asa king-of Judah, Elah son-of Baasha became-king over Israel in-Tirzah — two years.

**9** And-his-servant Zimri, commander-of half the-chariots, conspired against-him. And-he was in-Tirzah, drinking-himself-drunk in-the-house-of Arza, who was over the-house in-Tirzah.

**10** And-Zimri came and-struck-him and-killed-him, in-the-twenty-seventh year-of Asa king-of Judah, and-reigned in-his-place.

**11** And-it-was when-he-became-king, when-he-sat on his-throne, he-struck ʾet-all the-house-of Baasha. He-did-not leave to-him one-who-urinates-against-a-wall, nor-his-kinsman, nor-his-friend.

**12** And-Zimri destroyed ʾet-all the-house-of Baasha, according-to-the-word-of YHWH that he-spoke against Baasha by-the-hand-of Jehu the-prophet —

**13** because-of all the-sins-of Baasha and-the-sins-of Elah his-son that they-sinned and-that they-caused Israel to-sin, to-provoke YHWH the-God-of Israel with-their-vanities.

**14** And-the-rest-of the-acts-of Elah and-all that he-did — are-they not written in-the-Book-of the-Chronicles-of the-Kings-of Israel?

**15** In-the-twenty-seventh year-of Asa king-of Judah, Zimri reigned seven days in-Tirzah. And-the-people were-encamped against Gibbethon, that belonged-to the-Philistines.

**16** And-the-people who-were-encamped heard, saying, "Zimri has-conspired and-also has-struck the-king." And-all Israel made ʾet-Omri, commander-of the-army, king over Israel on-that day in-the-camp.

**17** And-Omri went-up, and-all Israel with-him, from-Gibbethon, and-they-besieged Tirzah.

**18** And-it-was when-Zimri saw that the-city was-taken, and-he-went into the-citadel-of the-house-of the-king and-burned ʾet-the-house-of the-king over-him with-fire, and-he-died —

**19** because-of his-sins that he-sinned, to-do the-evil in-the-eyes-of YHWH, to-walk in-the-way-of Jeroboam and-in-his-sin that he-did, to-cause Israel to-sin.

**20** And-the-rest-of the-acts-of Zimri and-his-conspiracy that he-conspired — are-they not written in-the-Book-of the-Chronicles-of the-Kings-of Israel?

**21** Then the-people-of Israel were-divided in-half: half the-people followed after Tibni son-of Ginath, to-make-him-king, and-half followed after Omri.

**22** And-the-people who-followed Omri prevailed over the-people who-followed Tibni son-of Ginath. And-Tibni died, and-Omri reigned.

**23** In-the-thirty-first year-of Asa king-of Judah, Omri became-king over Israel — twelve years. In-Tirzah he-reigned six years.

**24** And-he-bought ʾet-the-hill Samaria from-Shemer for-two talents-of silver. And-he-built on the-hill, and-called ʾet-the-name-of the-city that he-built after-the-name-of Shemer, lord-of the-hill — Samaria.

**25** And-Omri did the-evil in-the-eyes-of YHWH and-did-worse than-all who were before-him.

**26** And-he-walked in-all the-way-of Jeroboam son-of Nebat and-in-his-sin that he-caused Israel to-sin, to-provoke YHWH the-God-of Israel with-their-vanities.

**27** And-the-rest-of the-acts-of Omri that he-did and-his-might that he-showed — are-they not written in-the-Book-of the-Chronicles-of the-Kings-of Israel?

**28** And-Omri lay-down with his-fathers and-was-buried in-Samaria. And-Ahab his-son reigned in-his-place.

**29** And-Ahab son-of Omri became-king over Israel in-the-thirty-eighth year-of Asa king-of Judah. And-Ahab son-of Omri reigned over Israel in-Samaria twenty-two years.

**30** And-Ahab son-of Omri did the-evil in-the-eyes-of YHWH, above all who were before-him.

**31** And-it-was — was-it-a-light-thing, his-walking in-the-sins-of Jeroboam son-of Nebat? — and-he-took as-wife ʾet-Jezebel daughter-of Ethbaal king-of the-Sidonians, and-he-went and-served Baal and-bowed-down to-him.

**32** And-he-raised an-altar for-Baal in-the-house-of Baal that he-built in-Samaria.

**33** And-Ahab made ʾet-the-Asherah. And-Ahab did-more to-provoke YHWH the-God-of Israel than-all the-kings-of Israel who were before-him.

**34** In-his-days Hiel the-Bethelite built ʾet-Jericho. With-Abiram his-firstborn he-laid-its-foundation, and-with-Segub his-youngest he-set-up its-gates, according-to-the-word-of YHWH that he-spoke by-the-hand-of Joshua son-of Nun.

---
## EMET Textual Notes

1. **16:9 — "drinking-himself-drunk"**: Elah's reign ends as it was characterized — in drunkenness. The assassination during a drinking party underscores the moral bankruptcy of the northern monarchy.
2. **16:18 — "burned the-house-of the-king over-him"**: Zimri's seven-day reign ends in self-immolation — the shortest and most spectacular reign in Israelite history.
3. **16:24 — Samaria founded**: Omri purchases and builds the city that will become the northern kingdom's permanent capital. The name "Samaria" (Shomron) comes from the previous owner Shemer.
4. **16:31 — Jezebel**: The narrator's most ominous introduction. Ahab's marriage to Jezebel daughter of the Sidonian king brings Baal worship into the heart of Israel's government.
5. **16:34 — Hiel and Jericho**: Joshua's ancient curse (Josh 6:26) is fulfilled — Hiel's sons die as he rebuilds the cursed city. Prophetic words outlast centuries.

— EMET
